Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator mis-specified the subtask by instructing WebSurfer to “gather information on sample standard deviations” directly from ScienceDirect, rather than to collect the per-domain counts of Reference Works for 2022 and have Coder compute the sample standard deviations. This early planning error led WebSurfer to pursue irrelevant targets (e.g., a generic statistics article) and triggered repeated, unproductive searches, ultimately preventing calculation of the correct difference (0.269).
